concept: Glue: serverless ETL with crawlers and Data Catalog
tests: Choosing a serverless ETL service that crawls sources, infers schemas into a catalog and transforms data.
expected: AWS Glue: crawlers → Glue Data Catalog, serverless Spark ETL jobs. Triggers: "serverless ETL", "crawls data sources", "infers schemas into a catalog".
why_not: EMR requires cluster management; Data Pipeline on EC2 — servers; Redshift — a warehouse, not an ETL crawler.
